name: Chuugokugo de Moeyou! 1 -Native Shoujo no Anime Koe-
original_name: 中国語で萌えよう!1ーネイティブ少女のアニメ声ー
source:
One day, Touichi's class welcomes a Chinese girl.
He soon falls in love with her and tries to talk to her in Chinese.
His purpose is to confess his love to her in Chinese.

Voiced by a Chinese native speaker voice actress.
Every Chinese script has its Japanese translation.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE239048.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
某天，藤一的班级迎来一名中国女孩。他很快爱上她，并努力用中文与她交谈，目的是用中文向她告白。

由中文母语配音演员配音。
每段中文台词都附有日文翻译。

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE239048.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
